name: Hatoba Fujine
source:
The younger Hatoba twin and a second-year student, Fujine adores her sister Sakura so much that she sticks to her like glue whenever they go. Excelling at sports, she’s also in the lacrosse club.

Easygoing and cheerful almost to the point of idiocy, but also naturally beautiful, she’s uninterested in romance despite the number of students with crushes on her. She would much rather focus on sports and, of course, her big sister.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2680250/Holy_Maid_Academy/]Steam[/url]]
